resources.string: Enable Whispers in Settings → Chat to show the menu and receive new messages while HexStream is open.

Your Twitch conversations load when you open this screen. Select a person and scroll up for older messages, or use Load older messages. Refresh checks Twitch again.
History uses the active account’s Twitch login and never combines accounts. The most recent 500 messages are cached locally with device-key encryption. Clearing that cache leaves Twitch’s conversations unchanged.
New whispers arrive while HexStream is visible and connected. Reopening this inbox checks Twitch for missed messages. Background whisper notifications are not implemented. An accepted send is not a delivery receipt.
Remove this account’s locally cached messages? Twitch’s history stays unchanged and can be loaded again.
No conversations are loaded. Refresh to check Twitch; any loading or login problem appears above.
No messages are loaded in this conversation. Refresh to check Twitch.
